description: This header file declares internal functions for the Data Model Object Controller (DslhObjco), used within the DSL Home Model Implementation (DSLH). It includes prototypes for managing object instances, validation, engagement, commit, rollback, and parameter access functions.

methods.name: DslhObjcoGetInsContext
methods.description: Returns the handle to the instance context.

methods.name: DslhObjcoCheckInstance
methods.description: Checks if the object instance is valid.

methods.name: DslhObjcoCheckParamExistence
methods.description: Verifies if a parameter exists within the object.

methods.name: DslhObjcoCheckParamWritability
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is writable.

methods.name: DslhObjcoValidateHierarchyInterface
methods.description: Validates the hierarchy interface of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjcoEngage
methods.description: Initializes or engages the object controller.

methods.name: DslhObjcoValidate
methods.description: Validates the object controller with given interface.

methods.name: DslhObjcoCommit
methods.description: Commits changes made in the object controller.

methods.name: DslhObjcoRollback
methods.description: Rolls back changes to the previous state.

methods.name: DslhObjcoGetParamValueByName
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter by name.

methods.name: DslhObjcoGetBulkParamValue
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values in bulk.
